theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_cv_first_order_regularity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) ∧ (∀ y ∉ K, fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) y = 0) ∧ (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε, (∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (φ t)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ t))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
